notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45109603/4fff7035aff3a7712efee9076f426839b11d82a4.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2664370/Durak_NTR_the_Fool_who_lost_his_gf_in_a_card_game/

We’ve been listening to your feedback, and we know that some players—especially those new to Durak—wanted a little extra help getting into the game. So, we’re introducing a brand-new Hint System!

Now, you’ll notice a lightbulb button at the bottom of the game screen. When activated, it will highlight the cards you can play, making it easier to learn the mechanics and keep the game flowing smoothly. Whether you’re just getting started or stuck in a tricky situation, this feature is here to help!

We hope this makes your experience even better. As always, we appreciate your feedback—keep it coming, and let us know what you think!

See you at the table!

notes.title: Femdom Waifu: The Big, Juicy Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34574003/d93f2cada33e36efdf54582caa08d6cbe450e1cd.jpg

You asked — we delivered. It has been more than a half year since the last Femdom Waifu update.

Many of you thought we'd abandoned our first game and that there wouldn't be any further support for it... Many of you were afraid that this was the end of our beloved JOI simulator. Some of you even emailed us asking about the situation. 

And we've finally answered! 

Today, Femdom Waifu receives it's biggest update since launch. We've fixed animations, fixed visual bugs, improved game performance and most importantly... We've added more than 300 fresh text lines across all available game modes: standard, netorare, findom and even censored (!!!)...  If you were an avid Femdom Waifu player and want a fresh new game experience — don't be afraid to give it a try. We promise you won't be disappointed.

As the cherry on top, we've added the "maid" special outfit completely for free. You can find and select it in the "Special Outfits" section of the opening menu.

Thanks for supporting us, buddies. There is a lot of exciting news about our projects coming later this year. 

And we see something *fluffy* on the horizon.

Stay in touch and... 

See you at the session!

At first, I want to say a huge thank you to all those who played and left their feedback and suggestions. In fact, I was pleasantly surprised that such a niche game was so well received. I plan to regularly release content updates and another DLC is already on the way.

In its first content update, the game receives additional lines to the mistress text pool. It's part of regular updates which have a goal to keep game dialogue part as fresh as possible.

Glasses...
